The first clean-clone validator sequence stopped because ignored dist bytes omitted the frozen public-v0.0.23 predecessor archive; exact approved public assets were downloaded and verified before the unchanged validator passed.

limitations: GitHub has no configured checks or required review for PR #23, so repository, clean-clone, and direct public-state gates are authoritative.
Thirty-two-of-thirty-two observed-valid adversarial domain/outcome/split cells are synthetic evidence and not universal prompt-injection resistance.

Real operational infrastructure, production identity, immutable storage, external collectors, signing, paid services, and container packaging remain out of scope.
